name: dsh-approval-center
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: Windows notification-center approvals (approve/reject buttons) plus main-conversation turn completion and failure notifications — a task control center for human-in-the-loop approvals. Sub-agent notifications are always off.
author: xmwpoi

scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/host-contract.test.js test/identity-adapter.test.js test/queue.test.js test/store.test.js test/dialog.test.js test/dialog.scripts.test.js test/dialog.cleanup.test.js test/dialog.uri-handler.test.js test/dialog.unicode-mapping.test.js test/notifications.test.js test/notifications.adversarial.test.js test/notification-format.test.js test/approval-structured-gate.test.js test/task-toast-sender.test.js test/task-toast-script.test.js test/approval-card-layout.test.js
scripts.test:integration: node --import ./test/integration/hooks/register.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 test/integration/approval-flow.test.js test/integration/lifecycle.test.js test/integration/task-notifications.test.js test/integration/host-publication.test.js test/integration/agent-registry.test.js test/integration/session-title.test.js test/integration/agent-loop.test.js test/integration/approval-card-regression.test.js test/integration/approval-pair-rule.test.js
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
